Both are generated from the same local stores as the JSON export, use no server, and contain no name, email address or account identifier. | FAIR data stewardship calls for interoperable, reusable formats and machine-readable metadata; a nested JSON alone shifts flattening work and transcription risk to the study team. | 26978244; 41813053; R49; ADR-043 |
